text:
Maria Lopez: Quick preflight — we're running the geo-staggered webinar next Wed across US/EU/APAC. Need registration pages to auto-detect region and present local times, Zoom setup for staggered start windows, and lead routing to respective SDR queues. Draft plan:
- Reg page variants + timezone display
- Zoom instances per region + RTMP fallback
- Recording + transcript ownership
- Post-event nurture per-region
Who can own each? :raised_hands:

Samir Patel: I can take reg pages. I'll add language toggles and local time conversions. Linking current templates: https://app.asana.com/0/12345/67890

Neha Rao: I'll own Zoom config and recordings. Prefer separate Zoom accounts per region to avoid overlap. Need to confirm interpreters for APAC — is that happening live or via captions?

Zach Kim: SDR lead routing — map registrant region -> queue. Add hidden form field 'region' and pass UTM. Suggest TTL 48h for SDR follow-up before nurture. Dedupe by email.

Aj Chen: I'll do post-event nurture copy + highlight clips. Will localize CTAs and GDPR language for EU. Drafts will be ready by Tue.

Maria Lopez: Perfect. Add these as tasks in Asana and tag owners. Quick checklist:
```
- Reg pages: variant urls, timezone tag, hidden field 'region'
- Zoom: host acct per region, recording auto-upload, consent checkbox text
- Recording: transcript (Otter.ai), language labels in filename
- Lead flow: webhook -> HubSpot -> SDR queues, 24h SLA on first touch
- Post-event: 3 nurture emails (replay, highlights, demo CTA)
```

Samir Patel: Timeline: reg variants by Tue EOD. Need APAC copy from @Aj.

Neha Rao: Zoom config ready Wed morning. @EventBot please create meetings and enable cloud recording + passcode.

EventBot: meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/111111 (US, host: neha). meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/222222 (EU, host: neha). meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/333333 (APAC, host: neha).

Zach Kim: Lead mapping doc in Google Drive. Regex rules: if timezone == 'APAC' -> assign APAC-SDR; else if EU -> EU-SDR; else -> US-SDR.

Aj Chen: Nurture drafts posted: https://docs.google.com/drive/xxxxx. Legal review flagged for EU copy.

Maria Lopez: Two risks: 1) transcription + PII (ask security) 2) Zoom GDPR settings for EU recordings. @Neha confirm retention policy?

Neha Rao: EU host retention 90 days, US 30 days, APAC 180 days (customer request). Enabling waiting room + passcode. Will confirm in sec.

Samir Patel: Reg pages are QAed on mobile and desktop. Screenshots uploaded: https://imgur.com/xyz

Zach Kim: Webhook test successful. Example payload:
`{"email":"test@example.com","region":"EU","utm_source":"launch"}`

Maria Lopez: Great. Next steps: create Asana tasks, legal check on EU recording copy, ops runbook for hot-failures (zoom down). Sync at 14:00 PT today. :calendar:

Neha Rao: See you then.

Aj Chen: On it.

Maria Lopez: Thanks team :rocket:
